item.isekai_mahou.arcane_broom.desc: Fast free flight: it goes where you look. 1 seat; uses more energy.
item.isekai_mahou.flying_carpet.desc: Hovers low following the terrain and crosses water, lava and deserts. Efficient.
item.isekai_mahou.arcane_boat.desc: Very fast on rivers and oceans. Barely moves out of water.
item.isekai_mahou.golem_cart.desc: Walks over land climbing steps and carries a cargo chest (sneak + click to open).
item.isekai_mahou.mini_airship.desc: Slow, but climbs to any height and carries the party. Has a small hold (sneak + click).
item.isekai_mahou.vehicle.energy: Energy: the pilot's mana or Mana Crystals
message.isekai_mahou.vehicle_controls.fl: Look to steer · [%1$s] climb · [%2$s] descend (on the ground: dismount)
message.isekai_mahou.vehicle_controls.ho: Look to steer · [%1$s] climb · [%2$s] descend (on the ground: dismount)
message.isekai_mahou.vehicle_no_energy: Out of energy! Recover %s or charge the vehicle with a Mana Crystal.
message.isekai_mahou.vehicle_tank_full: The crystal tank is already full.
message.isekai_mahou.vehicle_not_owner: This vehicle belongs to someone else.
message.isekai_mahou.vehicle_no_room: There is no room for the vehicle here.
hint.isekai_mahou.vehicles.energy: The vehicle spends the pilot's %s; when short, it burns crystals: click it with a Mana Crystal.
hint.isekai_mahou.vehicles.placed: Click the vehicle to board. %s + hit packs it back into your inventory.
item.isekai_mahou.mana_rover.desc: Fast over land, climbs steps and carries a passenger. Small luggage rack (sneak + click).
item.isekai_mahou.tide_skiff.desc: Races over rivers and sea with 4 seats and a hold (sneak + click). Made for water cities.
item.isekai_mahou.sky_galleon.desc: Flying ship for 5, with a large hold (sneak + click). Made for sky cities.
item.isekai_mahou.vehicle_part_engine.de: Vehicle upgrade: +10% top speed and acceleration per level.
item.isekai_mahou.vehicle_part_armor.des: Vehicle upgrade: +40% health and −15% damage taken per level.
item.isekai_mahou.vehicle_part_storage.d: Vehicle upgrade: +9 cargo slots per level (a vehicle without a chest gets one).
item.isekai_mahou.vehicle_part.use: Click YOUR vehicle to install (up to level %s). It stays even when packed.
item.isekai_mahou.vehicle_repair_kit.des: Click a vehicle: restores %s%% of its health.
message.isekai_mahou.vehicle_whole: The vehicle is already in one piece.
message.isekai_mahou.vehicle_part_max: %s is already at max level on this vehicle.
message.isekai_mahou.vehicle_critical: Vehicle badly damaged! Fix it with a Repair Kit or at a Mechanic.
message.isekai_mahou.vehicle_wrecked: Your %s was destroyed at %s %s %s. The cargo is on the ground; a Mechanic can rebuild it.
message.isekai_mahou.vehicle_recalled: The Mechanic already recovered this vehicle: this old copy fell apart.
message.isekai_mahou.mechanic.ask.vehicl: Repair %1$s (health %2$s%%) for %3$s coins? Click again to confirm.
Rebuild %1$s, which was destroyed, for %3$s coins? Click again to confirm.
Recover %1$s (health %2$s%%), left far away, for %3$s coins? The old copy vanishes. Click again to confirm.
message.isekai_mahou.mechanic.done.rebui: %s was rebuilt: it is in your inventory.
message.isekai_mahou.mechanic.done.recov: %s was recovered: it is in your inventory.
message.isekai_mahou.mechanic.summary: Your vehicles: %s out in the world, %s packed, %s destroyed.
message.isekai_mahou.mechanic.summary.no: You have no vehicles in my logbook yet.
hint.isekai_mahou.vehicles.mechanic: Mechanic! Sells vehicles (more kinds with each Workshop level), upgrade parts and Repair Kits. %s + click: repairs, rebuilds a destroyed one or recovers a lost one.
hint.isekai_mahou.vehicles.mechanic.worl: Mechanic: vehicles and parts under Trade (more vehicles with more standing in the kingdom). Under Services he repairs, rebuilds a destroyed vehicle and recovers a lost one.
hint.isekai_mahou.vehicles.wrecked: Vehicle destroyed! The cargo fell on the ground. Any Mechanic rebuilds it, upgrades included — on the plaza of world cities or in your city's Mechanic's Workshop.
